title: 第八百九十五章 所有人的希望第八百九十四章 第四极
slug: 武道长生从大离第一纨绔开始
content_zh:
斩岳城王宫地下，一座禁制之力封锁的地宫。
宽阔的四方宫殿，空空如也，只有地面上，密密麻麻的古老符文，交织成一副玄奥的图案。
此时，裂空王就站在阵图中心，顾尘风、冥九幽和姬千秋，在一旁等待。
“殷道友，你真的能够将顾道友，送出结界空间？”此时姬千秋依旧有些难以置信。
就在刚才，殷红鸾表示，她可以将顾尘风送到结界外的安全之地，由他自行前往五雷神山。
并带着三人来到此地。
此时，殷红鸾手握巨刃，缓缓吐纳气息。
“本王之所以用‘裂空’二字作为王号，是因为我族在上界，便名为‘裂空族’。
裂空一族有一门秘法，可以引动空间法则，直接空间挪移。
但夺圣之地乃是禁法之地，想要施展这门秘法，必须要这座大阵加持。
顾道友，待会儿我会为你斩出一道空间通道。
你若相信本王，就在我出手的瞬间，进入空间通道，因为我最多能够维持一息时间。”
此言一出，顾尘风三人都不禁有些吃惊，没想到殷红鸾还有如此逆天手段。
冥九幽不禁开口问道：“殷道友，既然你能将顾道友送出去，能不能把我们都送出去？”
殷红鸾冷冷扫了他一眼。
“裂空秘法消耗极大，我施展一次，需要间隔很久，才能使用第二次。
而且，我们三人必须留下，才能维持结界现状。”
“呃……”冥九幽缩了缩脖子。
“我也只是随口问一问。”
旋即他又忍不住看向顾尘风，出言提醒。

“顾道友，此次你若能离开这座结界，可一定要想办法尽快突破，赶来相助我们。
就算你不为我们考虑，也要为殷道友和她腹中的孩子考虑呀。”
顾尘风闻言，表情不禁有些古怪，随即他朝三人郑重承诺。
“三位尽管放心，三位能够带领乱星域，对抗天圣城，就是我七星大陆最牢靠的盟友。
无论我能否达到亚圣实力，顾某都一定会想尽办法，拯救乱星域的。”
得到顾尘风的承诺，冥九幽这才放心了不少。
“好了，我要出手了！”
此时，殷红鸾已经将气息调整至巅峰状态。
修长身躯屹立于地宫阵图中央，脚下阵图忽然震动。
无数符文骤然亮起，一股磅礴的能量顺着阵图，迅速涌入殷红鸾体内。
她双目精光暴涨，气势瞬间攀升至巅峰，手中巨刃嗡鸣震颤。
“开！”
一声暴喝，殷红鸾高挑身躯，如紧绷的弓弦骤然释放。
content_en:
Underneath the royal palace of Zhanyue City, there is an underground palace sealed by the power of prohibition.
The vast square palace was empty, with only ancient runes on the ground densely intertwined into a mysterious pattern.
At this time, the King of Cracking Sky was standing in the center of the formation, with Gu Chenfeng, Ming Jiuyou and Ji Qianqiu waiting on the side.
"Fellow Daoist Yin, can you really send Friend Daoist Gu out of the enchantment space?" At this time, Ji Qianqiu was still a little unbelievable.
Just now, Yin Hongluan said that she could send Gu Chenfeng to a safe place outside the barrier and let him go to the Five Thunder Mountains on his own.
And brought three people here.
At this time, Yin Hongluan held the giant blade in his hand and breathed out slowly.
“The reason why I use the word ‘Split Kong’ as my royal title is because our clan is in the upper realm, so we are called the ‘Split Kong Clan’.
The Rinkong clan has a secret method that can activate the laws of space and directly move space.
But the Holy Land is a place of forbidden magic. If you want to use this secret method, you must have the blessing of this great formation.
Fellow Daoist Gu, I will cut a space passage for you later.
If you believe in me, enter the space channel at the moment I take action, because I can maintain it for one breath at most. "
As soon as these words came out, Gu Chenfeng and the other two people couldn't help but be a little surprised. They didn't expect Yin Hongluan to have such a defiant method.
Ming Jiuyou couldn't help but ask: "Fellow Daoist Yin, since you can send fellow Daoist Gu out, can you send us all out?"
Yin Hongluan glanced at him coldly.
"The secret method of splitting the sky consumes a lot of money. If I use it once, it will take a long time before I can use it a second time.
Moreover, the three of us must stay to maintain the status quo of the barrier. "
"Uh..." Ming Jiuyou shrank his neck.
"I'm just asking casually."
Then he couldn't help but look at Gu Chenfeng and warned him.
"Fellow Daoist Gu, if you can leave this barrier this time, you must find a way to break through as soon as possible and come to help us.
Even if you don't think about us, you still have to think about Taoist friend Yin and the child in her belly. "
When Gu Chenfeng heard this, his expression couldn't help but be a little strange, and then he made a solemn promise to the three of them.
"Don't worry about the three of you. The three of you who can lead the Chaos Star Territory to fight against Tiansheng City are our strongest allies in the Seven Star Continent.
Regardless of whether I can reach the level of Ya Sheng, Gu will definitely try his best to save Chaos Star Territory. "
After receiving Gu Chenfeng's promise, Ming Jiuyou felt relieved.
"Okay, I'm going to take action!"
At this time, Yin Hongluan had adjusted his aura to its peak state.
The slender body stood in the center of the underground palace formation, and the formation under his feet suddenly shook.
Countless runes suddenly lit up, and a majestic energy quickly poured into Yin Hongluan's body along the formation diagram.
The light in her eyes skyrocketed, her aura instantly reached its peak, and the giant blade in her hand buzzed and trembled.
"Open!"
With a loud shout, Yin Hongluan's tall body suddenly released like a tight bowstring.
